coverage.landlord_size_condition: Applies to any rental property owner owning one or more rental residential dwelling units. A person holding a controlling interest in an owning entity is treated as a single owner with that entity.
coverage.summary: Covers residential dwelling units in New Jersey: houses, apartments, accessory units and other units intended as a primary residence. Excludes inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care, and detention or correctional facilities.

result.notes: Removed other_conditions. Its content (the coordinating-function and algorithmic-device exclusions) defines regulated conduct, not covered buildings, units or owners. It is already reflected in the rule's exemptions field. requires_unknown_facts is set to false because the act covers ordinary residential rental units statewide. The Section 6(b) preemption supports may_preempt_local_rules=true and yields_to_local_rule=false. Whether the act actually conflicts with the Jersey City and Hoboken ordinances remains unresolved, as the conflict_note states.
